prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production source artwork for an actual 2D botanical nest growth animation, NOT a preview. Image 1 is the exact approved adult nest. Image 2 is the exact baby nest, for identity and materials only. Draw ONLY THE TWO LARGE FRONT IVORY PETALS as a coherent PAIR, in four opening states. Remove all gold beans, sprouts, rear pointed leaves, basal green leaves, vines, ground, shadows, scenery and effects from this artwork. The petals must have complete clean hidden lower roots. True transparent RGBA background, no painted background and no checkerboard.

Layout: strict 2-column by 2-row atlas, four equal square cells with a generous transparent gutter. Same camera, same scale, same bottom petal hinge point in every cell. Each cell uses the same coordinate frame: both petals meet at x=50% and y=82%; fully open pair spans x=18% to82%, y=44% to82%. The fully closed pair can be taller, about y=28% to82%, keeping volume. These are the SAME two petals in all four cells, do not redraw as a different flower.

Row-major order: top-left fully CLOSED pair, tips touching neatly at center above the bean's former position, soft curved center seam, full plump ivory bud with pale sage shading. Top-right just beginning to open, tips separated slightly, approximately 20% open; tips have the beginning of the original inward curl. Bottom-left 55% OPEN, thick fleshy petals bending outward from their lower hinge, inward curled tips clearly forming, the pair's central V opening readable. Bottom-right FULLY OPEN pair matching the two large FRONT petals in image 1 EXACTLY: the original wide cupped side profiles, rounded inward rolled tips, original height-to-width ratio, original lower hinge.

Keep the exact original ivory-to-sage palette, soft smooth hand-painted shading, fine dark green-teal outline, lighting from the upper left, slightly elevated front camera and thickness. Petal roots stay together and complete, not amputated. No straight cut edges, no ghost contours or blended poses. No new leaves or loose pixels. No text, numbers, cell borders or guides. Render polished continuous curves, not pixel art. The open cell's silhouette and coloring must be faithful to image 1. All four objects fit fully inside their own cell, nothing touches cell edges.
